Sweetwater Support Case #10879081 - UVC-01 USB Video Capture Device

Hi,

I have a customer that purchased a Roland UVC-01 video capture device and they are running into issues capturing video on Windows 10 through OBS and the video capture program, Debut by NCH. We are plugging the UVC-01 into a USB 3 port on the computer, I verified that the UVC is showing up under a USB 3 port in device manager.

When we open OBS or Debut, we can select the UVC as a video capture device and the preview window receives video from the UVC for about 1 second but then the video freezes. When this happens, the UVC is still recognized by the computer in device manager but I noticed that the UVC firmware update application does not recognize the UVC until we unplug it and plug it back in. Once we do this, we can go through the same setup in OBS or Debut but the issue persists.

I did update the firmware and the issue persists. I also had the customer try multple different USB 3 ports and the issue persists. The customer is using a USB 3 PCIe card that has a Renesas USB controller chipset and was wondering if you have seen issues with this chipset before? I am having the customer try the UVC on a different computer that has USB 3 ports to narrow down the issue.

Let me know if you have any thoughts on what is causing the issue or if it sounds like the UVC may be defective. I have attached a copy of the NFO file from the customer's computer in case that is helpful for you.

Best regards,

Mario Cervantes
Senior Tech Support Specialist
También Hablo Español
Sweetwater Sound

Operational Troubles BR-800

Product: BR-800
Serial Code: C5E3364
Purchased Date: 2021-05-31
Purchased Method: Online
Purchased Store: ALABAMA MUSIC
Comment: Hi costumer support, thanks for your time

I got a BR800 digital recorder and it’s given me different kind of troubles I will be as specific as I can

First the 3-position power switch it’s really a two position switch I got (Power On)- (Power On) - (Power USB) there’s no Power off response, hardware it’s in perfect condition.

2- Every time I power up it says “ USB FIRMWARE UPDATE, Update?” No “exit” or “enter” command response. So I went to the Boss website and download the firmware link, now I got installed Ver1.10 before it was 1.12!? What does that mean? 

Finally the rhythm edit software/waveConv/ControlSurface isn’t working in general, the pc connection via USB cable doesn’t seem to work as it should. I take care of the unit very well; it’s seem like a system problem. Once you are working on the recording purposes  everything works fine. I already try the factory reset, hope you can reconfigure everything I really like this old school way of work instead of conventional DAWs

Unfortunately, I am unable to install the USB driver or I do not know whether it is due to the cable connection. I connected the device with a USB cable via an adapter plug from USB C to USB 2. Can this cause problems? Will a driver update be available in the foreseeable future or is there a patch? Thank you, 

Joi

IDEA: DAW Mode

Zenbeats is a great product, but I have noticed that for those of us who replaced lesser DAWS (like FL Studio) with Zenbeats, it's not as easy to get to DAW mode or to a page where one can use it as a DAW.

Mainly, the page where we can access VSTs like our Legendary and AIRA series VSTs.

Could you please add a menu shortcut that opens a new song and takes us directly to the instrument page, i.e. "DAW Mode" ?

Pre sales advice

 Category: Keyboards
 Product: No Data
 Phone Number: No Data
 Postal Code: No Data
 Comment: Please forward it to Produktreparatur Orgel - thank you!

 Good day.
 I recently gave my organ, a Roland AT70, for repair because of a few minor defects.
 The following errors were involved:
 1. When switching on, a whistling sound of varying intensity occurred occasionally, but it disappeared again after a short time.
 2. Occasionally there was unevenly strong noise; the louder the volume, the stronger the noise.
 3. The sill was permanently defective.
 Overall, however, the organ was easy to play and, apart from the function of the sill, was also fully functional.
 The sill has now been repaired in the workshop, but the overall condition of the organ has deteriorated to such an extent that it is currently no longer usable. It now has extremely strong background noises and, depending on the setting, no tones can be produced at all.
 I would now like to ask you for a brief comment on the testimony of the technician who repaired the organ:
 He said the organ's capacitors had leaked, which was a common phenomenon on old organs. This would corrode conductor tracks on the board and the defect pattern could change at any time. He was therefore not responsible for the new errors that occurred on the organ. He also describes the condition of the organ as irreparable.
 What irritates me, however, is the following:
 The error pattern was constant before repair and the organ was playable. However, the technician claims that he did nothing on the organ apart from a fault diagnosis, which has been proven to be incorrect because he repaired the rocker panel. Since the organ is now, unfortunately, a "total loss", I would like to know from you whether the technician's description of the fault could basically apply, or whether it is not more likely that the technician made a mistake while repairing the sill.
 I would still like to have the organ repaired.
 Kind regards
 Anne Reinkober

Pre Sales Advice

Category: Keyboards
Product: No Data
Phone Number: No Data
Postal Code: No Data
Comment: Weiterleitung bitte an Produktreparatur Orgel - danke!

Guten Tag.
Ich habe kürzlich meine Orgel, eine Roland AT70, wegen ein paar kleinerer Defekte zur Reparatur gegeben.
Es handelte sich dabei um folgende Fehler:
1.	Beim Einschalten trat gelegentlich ein Pfeifton unterschiedlicher Intensität auf, der aber nach kurzer Zeit wieder verschwand.
2.	Gelegentlich trat unterschiedlich starkes Rauschen auf; je lauter die Lautstärke eingestellt war, desto stärker war das Rauschen.
3.	Der Schweller war permanent defekt.
Insgesamt war die Orgel aber gut bespielbar und abgesehen von der Funktion des Schwellers auch voll funktionsfähig.
In der Werkstatt wurde nun der Schweller repariert, der Zustand der Orgel insgesamt aber soweit verschlechtert, dass sie aktuell nicht mehr brauchbar ist. Sie weist jetzt extrem starke Störgeräusche auf und je nach Einstellung sind gar keine Töne mehr produzierbar.
Ich möchte Sie nun um eine kurze Stellungnahme zu der Aussage des Technikers, der die Orgel repariert hat, bitten:
Er sagte, dass die Kondensatoren der Orgel ausgelaufen seien, was ein häufiges Phänomen alter Orgeln sei. Dadurch würden Leiterbahnen auf der Platine verätzen und das Fehlerbild könne sich hierdurch jederzeit ändern. Für die neu aufgetretenen Fehler an der Orgel sei er somit nicht verantwortlich. Zudem beschreibt er den Zustand der Orgel als irreparabel.
Was mich irritiert, ist jedoch Folgendes:
Das Fehlerbild war vor Reparatur konstant und die Orgel gut bespielbar. Der Techniker behauptet aber, außer einer Fehlerdiagnose nichts an der Orgel gemacht zu haben, was nachweislich nicht stimmt, da er den Schweller repariert hat. Da die Orgel nun leider ein „Totalschaden“ ist, würde ich von Ihnen gerne wissen, ob die Fehlerbeschreibung des Technikers grundsätzlich zutreffen könnte, oder ob es nicht doch wahrscheinlicher ist, dass dem Techniker ein Fehler bei der Reparatur des Schwellers unterlaufen ist.
Ich würde die Orgel noch immer gerne reparieren lassen.
MfG
Anne Reinkober

I use the Roland Zenology Lite with MainStage in my Gig Set with my old MacBook Pro which uses the Mac OS 10.13.6 High Sierra (the last Mac OS what MacBook Pro support).
I plan to upgrade Zenology Lite to Pro -version, BUT... I noticed about Zenology's System Requirements requires Mac OS 10.14, 10.15 or 11 (for both versions) - however I use almost daily it without troubles with Mac 10.13.6.
Now I think... is it possible that my Zenology Lite STOP the working suddenly - ex. in gig in live progress??? I scared...!
And... dare I upgrade anymore at all to Pro -version?

Reordering user patches and using livesets GT-1000

Product: GT-1000
Serial Code: A5K5119
Purchased Date: 2019-10-27
Purchased Method: Online
Purchased Store: GAK - The Guitar, Amp and Keyboard (Brighton)
Comment: Good afternoon
I have been enjoying my GT1000 and am finally going to be able to use it at a gig! 
So, I need my user-created patches in the correct order to reflect our set list. I am using Boss Tone Studio and was expecting to be able to highlight a patch and then drag it to a different position, between two other patches. It was not possible to do this.
So, I read the knowledge bases and thought that a liveset was the answer. I could create a liveset and copy patches into it, in the correct order. But then, I couldn’t see how you use the liveset – there is no option on the device to select any liveset. I thought I would save it on the computer and then export it to the device but it simply overwrote the existing user patches starting at 01-1 (which was irritating as I then had to recreate some).
What is the best way to reorder my patches so they appear in the required order?
Thanks

Serial Code: A5K5119
Purchased Date: 2019-10-27
Purchased Method: Online
Purchased Store: GAK - The Guitar, Amp and Keyboard (Brighton)
Comment: Good afternoon
I have been enjoying my GT1000 and am finally going to be able to use it at a gig! 
So, I need my user-created patches in the correct order to reflect our set list. I am using Boss Tone Studio and was expecting to be able to highlight a patch and then drag it to a different position, between two other patches. It was not possible to do this.
So, I read the knowledge bases and thought that a liveset was the answer. I could create a liveset and copy patches into it, in the correct order. But then, I couldn’t see how you use the liveset – there is no option on the device to select any liveset. I thought I would save it on the computer and then export it to the device but it simply overwrote the existing user patches starting at 01-1 (which was irritating as I then had to recreate some).
What is the best way to reorder my patches so they appear in the required order?
Thanks

 Hi Steve,

 Have you ever heard of the following (sending program change from the MC-707 extending with MSB and LSB)?

 I'm still running into this. Especially in combination with the System-1m, which still uses LSB to adjust banks A to H and Program change can therefore only select the 8 patches of the currently selected bank.

Maybe there is something i missed somewhere.

regards.

Are there any known problems , in combination with other programs on mac os catalina 10.15.7 ? Must I update to the latest mac os ? I love your service, but its not fun to pay for a service I cant enjoy.

Regards from Fred Brenno

Feature Request: Mute control for piano engine DP603 (Polished White)

Product: DP603 (Polished White)
Serial Code: Z3M1473
Purchased Date: 2021-07-10
Purchased Method: Online
Purchased Store: Absolute Music (Ringwood Road)

TD-17 questions

 ROLAND / TD-17KVX-S Electronic drum set
 About the operation of Drum Sound Module TD-17

 I checked the instruction manual, but it's hard to understand the operation.

 The content of the question is as follows

 1. When registering an external audio file from UserSample using an SD card, is it necessary to create a folder called "Import" on the SD in advance?

 2. Whether multiple files can be deleted at once when deleting external audio files from UserSample using SD card

 3. Regarding the flow of registering the imported file in DrumKit, select any Drumkit (such as a free User after 51) → press the User Sample button there → hit the pad you want to change → select Import and then use your favorite audio file Select Assign → Register to Main
 * Does the above match?

 Also, when registering for a hi-hat, I would like to register both HH_Closed and HH_Open, but main is HH_Closed,
 I assigned HH_Open to sub, but for some reason it didn't apply.

 4. I would like to put together external audio files as a package, but whether such display can be done with the TD-17 (Electro, Rock, etc.)
 * As far as I confirmed, the Import material was simply lined up as a file from the User Sample button.

 5. Whether you can change the order of each audio sample imported above (I want to prioritize favorites from top to bottom)

 6. How to return to the initial state if you unintentionally change the settings of an existing pad preset (such as Modern Jazz or Alternative that is already in Drum Kit)

 7. Do you recognize that it is impossible to import other than wav files?
 * Is it possible to guess the cause of some wav files that could not be read?

 8. Conversion of default volume and Relese time for each pad. I would like to adjust the gain, Attack, Release, etc. by applying an effector instead of using the imported material as it is. Is this possible? I would like to know how to do it if possible.
text.value_o:
TD-17 questions

ROLAND ( ローランド ) / TD-17KVX-S 電子ドラムセットにおける
Drum Sound Module TD-17の操作についてです

説明書は確認しましたが、いまいち動作が理解しづらいです。

質問内容は以下

1.SDカードを用いてUserSampleより外部オーディオファイルを登録する場合、事前にSD上で「Import」というフォルダを作る必要があるのか。

2.SDカードを用いてUserSampleより外部オーディオファイルをDeleteする場合に複数を一括削除可能かどうか

3.ImportしたファイルをDrumKitに登録する流れに関して
任意のDrumkitを選択(51以降の空いているUserなど)→そこでUserSampleボタンを押す→変更したいパッドを叩く→Importを選択後、好みのオーディオファイルでAssignを選択→Mainへ登録
*上記で合っていますか？

また、ハイハットへの登録の場合、HH_ClosedとHH_Openのどちらも登録したいのですが、mainをHH_Closed、
subにHH_Openを割り当てましたが、なぜか適用されませんでした。

4.外部オーディオファイルをパッケージとしてまとめておきたいのですが、そういった表示をTD-17で行えるかどうか(ElectroとかRock等)
＊確認した限りでは、UserSampleボタンより単にImport素材がファイルとして並んでいるだけでした

5.上記でImportした各オーディオサンプルの順を変更できるかどうか(お気に入りを上から優先順にしたい)

6.既存のパッドのプリセット(DrumKitにすでにあるModernJazzとかAlternativeなど)の設定を意図せず変更してしまった場合に、初期状態に戻す方法

7.Importする際はwavファイル以外は不可能という認識であっているか。
*一度wavファイルでも読み込めないものがあったが原因の推測はできますでしょうか。

8.パッド毎のデフォルト音量やReleseタイムなどの変換。Importした素材をそのままではなく、エフェクタを
かけてゲインやAttack,Releaseなどを調整したいのですが、できますか。可能な場合方法が知りたいです。

Linear Sequencer Please FANTOM 8

Product: FANTOM 8
Serial Code: Z6K1882
Purchased Date: 2020-12-28
Purchased Method: Online
Purchased Store: SWEETWATER SOUND INC
Comment: Dear Roland, Please give us musicians the ability to manipulate and load Standard MIDI Files (SMFs) in your future OS updates beyond V2.50. (You know, as we did on the Roland DisCover 5, but through Fantom USB Memory Port)... It would be great to be able to load my previous compositions into Fantom's USB Memory Port and then reassign the GM/MIDI/SMF tracks to have new Fantom polyphony sounds and enhance our own previous arrangements, (in keeping our old school stuff fresh). It should be a very simple thing for your OS engineers to do... Fantom should be MIDI file friendly (as a MIDI instrument) without all the hassle of having to do all the 32 group, groupings, math, and write nightmare logistics when trying to just load a simple gig-ready GM/MIDI/SMF file (With proper Patch Assignments) into Fantom. Heck, the Roland Discover 5 has been able to do this simple two-step import/export process for years, ~ yet the Roland flagship can't do it??? Does that sound right to you??? It is very frustrating. Trying not to have to recreate scenes of my existing pro MIDI files and personal compositions. Besides, I already have all my files on USB flash drives, and many from the 3.5 Floppy's produced from an old Roland DisCover 5. But getting GM/MIDI/SMF into the Fantom is a total nightmare... Is anyone at Roland working on getting us consumers a functional Linear Sequencer?  A functional Linear Sequencer with one step importing and exporting and manipulation of GM/MIDI/SMF files??? This is crucial to this consumer as both a keyboard artist and a performance vocalist. I'm NOT looking for a political answer to my question here, just give it to me straight, please... Other than this one ask for a Linear Sequencer, both my Fantom and your customer support at Roland, and your vendors at Sweetwater have all been fantastic. I look forward to your direct answer and being a Roland consumer for many years. Thank you. All my very best, ~ Mike

Speaker Sound Quality LX706 (Dark Rosewood)

Product: LX706 (Dark Rosewood)
Serial Code: Z6K1205
Purchased Date: 2021-07-08
Purchased Method: In a store
Purchased Store: PIANO PLANET
Comment: I recently purchased this LX706 from a local piano dealer. I chose this particular digital piano because I am a fan of Roland instruments, and I think build quality is superb. 

However, upon delivery of this piano, I noticed a slight speaker buzz which is made when I play anything in the two octaves above middle C. And before it is asked--I did troubleshoot to see if anything in the surrounding environment was causing the sound (the piano is not touching anything and is away from any windows/walls) and it wasn't. Also, I don't hear the sound when I plug headphones in. The sound is beautiful with headphones. Also worth mentioning, I cannot hear the sound when playing notes in the bass clef, so the buzz is most likely coming from the mid-high range frequencies. 

Furthermore, I tried doing a factory reset to see if that did anything, but it didn't. 

I really love how this piano looks and feels, so it is heartbreaking to me to hear this bad sound come from such a beautiful piano. 

Also, as a side note. I want to resolve this issue without involving the local piano dealer as he may not believe me. I had a similar issue with another cheaper digital piano I bought from Piano Planet, but he could not hear the sound I was talking about, so I assume it would be a similar situation with this piano.

text.value:
Concerto M1 compatibility

Hello, 

I recently upgraded to a new Mac mini with the M1 Chip. All of my other Roland plug-ins are working, except for Concerto. I know that everything has to be redone because of Macs new chip. When can I expect a fix/update to Concerto to make it compatible with the Apple M1?

Thank you,

Kyle Rittweger

text.value:
Copy Patterns to Another Group TR-06

 Product: TR-06
 Serial Code: Z7L0111
 Purchased Date: 2021-04-24
 Purchased Method: Online
 Purchased Store: Others
 Comment: Hello,
 I cannot find the following information in the Roland database and the manual: I would like to know if it is possible for the TR-06 to copy a pattern from one bank / group to another group (for example Pattern # 1 from Group 1 to Pattern # 2 from Group 8).
 If so, what is the procedure?
 Thanks in advance.
 Regards.
 Laurent

D'avance merci.
Cordialement.
Laurent

Promo membership extension

Hey guys, 
I've got an ultimate subscription after buying a Jupiter X in march but because I already had an ultimate subscription running I sent an email to support about this, and they told me that the new subscription should start after the main subscription expires and not having overlapping ultimate subscription, but I'm checking on my account status now and the Jupiter X Ultimate subscription starting date is March 2021 and not July 24th 2021. Can you check it, please?
Thanks!

text.value:
Malfunction when stepping on pitch bend and sustain pedal FA-06

 Product: FA-06
 Serial Code: A8F4253
 Purchased Date: 2019-04-19
 Purchased Method: In a store
 Purchased Store: Ishibashi Musical Instrument Store Ikebukuro Store
 Comment: Immediately after using pitch bend, it is frequent, and recently, even if I do not use it, the pitch goes up.
 There is nothing wrong with stepping on the sustain pedal, but once you step on it, it will be in the following state.
 If you don't step on the pedal, the sound will remain so quiet that you can hardly hear it, and this will not be resolved over time. Also, if you press the pedal again in this state, the volume will probably be the volume you originally set or will be louder. If you step on this pedal, sustain will be applied.
 In addition, there are some problems such as the demo sound source flowing out without permission.
text.value_o:
ピッチベンドとサステインペダルを踏んだ時の不調 FA-06

Product: FA-06
Serial Code: A8F4253
Purchased Date: 2019-04-19
Purchased Method: In a store
Purchased Store: 石橋楽器店 池袋店
Comment: ピッチベンドを使用した直後は高頻度で、最近は使用しなくてもピッチが上がった状態になったりしてしまいます。
サステインペダルは踏まなければなにも問題ないのですが、一度踏むと、以下のような状態になります。
ペダルを踏まない状態だと音がほとんど聞こえないくらい小さい状態が続き、これは時間によって解決しない。また、この状態でペダルを再度踏むと、音量はおそらく元々設定していたであろう音量になるかまたは大きな音量になります。このペダルを踏んだ場合、サステインは適用されます。
そのほかにもデモ音源が勝手に流れ出すなどの不調がみられます。

sents.t: Malfunction when stepping on pitch bend and sustain pedal FA-06
Ishibashi Musical Instrument Store Ikebukuro Store
Immediately after using pitch bend, it is frequent, and recently, even if I do not use it, the pitch goes up.
There is nothing wrong with stepping on the sustain pedal, but once you step on it, it will be in the following state.
If you don't step on the pedal, the sound will remain so quiet that you can hardly hear it, and this will not be resolved over time.
Also, if you press the pedal again in this state, the volume will probably be the volume you originally set or will be louder.
If you step on this pedal, sustain will be applied.
In addition, there are some problems such as the demo sound source flowing out without permission.

Compatible power adaptor for the Roland CP-40 A-01

Product: A-01
Serial Code: 0000000
Purchased Date: 1989-06-19
Purchased Method: In a store
Purchased Store: TOM LEE MUSIC
Comment: Hello Roland Support,
I have a Roland CP-40, Pitch to MIDI Converter, but I'm missing the power adaptor.  
I understand that this piece of equipment has been discontinued; however, I wanted to find out if Roland had any similar devices who's power adaptor might work with the CP-40.
If you have any questions please feel free to ask.
Many thanks for your assistance.
Regards,
Dave

text.value:
Amp does not connect to TONE STUDIO KATANA-50 MkII (KTN-50 2)

Product: KATANA-50 MkII (KTN-50 2)
Serial Code: A6K6123
Purchased Date: 2020-11-02
Purchased Method: Secondhand
Purchased Store: No Data
Comment: I've been using my amp with my laptop running macOS 14 for a long time and it worked fine. However, everything broke after I upgraded to macOS 14.6. I have the right drivers and program for my system and product. I even deleted the driver and tone studio and installed from boss website anew, but it did not fix this problem. 

After selecting which device to connect to, the program tells me that I'm running an older version of KATANA mkii (even though both the program and the firmware on my amp are the latest versions). And then it would not connect to it (even though it had just prompted me to select whether or not I want to use the amp or the DAW, which indicates that the hardware is connected).

sents.t: Amp does not connect to TONE STUDIO
I've been using my amp with my laptop running macOS 14 for a long time
However, everything broke after I upgraded to macOS 14.6.
I have the right drivers and program for my system and product.
I even deleted the driver and tone studio and installed from boss website anew, but it did not fix this problem.
After selecting which device to connect to, the program tells me that I'm running an older version of KATANA mkii (even though both the program and the firmware on my amp are the latest versions).
And then it would not connect to it (even though it had just prompted me to select whether or not I want to use the amp or the DAW, which indicates that the hardware is connected).

text.value:
Firmware 4.0 bug KATANA-HEAD (KTN-HEAD)

Product: KATANA-HEAD (KTN-HEAD)
Serial Code: z2j8460
Purchased Date: 2019-03-29
Purchased Method: In a store
Purchased Store: GUITAR CENTER #446
Comment: Hello. I'm one of those Katana MK1 owners, having a problem after updating firmware to V4, latest official one. After power-up, panel gain (and maybe equalizer) value overwrites current preset settings. It is a known issue, and switching preset back and forth helps, but still an annoyance. I saw a few reports of the same issue, but never a solution.
Is there any known fix to it, other than downgrading to V3.2 ? Maybe some un-official patched V4 firmware revision?
Thanks.

text.name: description
text.value:
Another really cool demonstration of how the RT-MicS can be a simple and creative tool for acoustic drums!

 In this play by @rnbatera , the drum set box is being amplified by the RT-MicS' own microphone, and little by little the musician can choose the best moment to add exclusive samples at every touch!

 Did you like it? Comment below what you thought of this experience!

 #drums #roland #drummer #rtmics

Sweetwater Support Case #10877606 - 61-key FA Series Workstation

Hello,

I am assisting a customer who is experiencing an issue when playing his FA06 keyboard.  It seems that he is unable to permanently assign Leslie/ tremolo effect to the pitch bend wheel. 

Just for some background, the customer had the Juno and decided to upgrade. Apparently the Juno has a function where you can assign a Leslie/ tremolo effect to a mod wheel, and the effect will continue if you let go of the control. Is there a way to do this on the FA06?  The customer is frustrated that he can’t play with both hands while continuing the rotary speaker effect. 

Is there a button that could be assigned, or a foot controller, or any other means by which the customer could accomplish this?  Suggestions will be appreciated!

Thank you,
Garri George
Sweetwater Sound
Product Support Specialist

There is no place to adjust MIDI volume in Windows 10 (I'm pretty sure the MIDI volume is muted). So what can I do? If you cannot solve this problem for me, can I still get a refund after more than a year of purchase?

Boss RC-500 Not Recognised By Computer RC-500

Product: RC-500
Serial Code: A9L3512
Purchased Date: 2021-06-22
Purchased Method: Online
Purchased Store: Amazon.co.uk (Dunfermline) (Dunfermline)
Comment: Hi

I have tried to update my RC500's system software using the steps listed on your website to version 1.04, but I cannot get any of my computers to recognise the device in order to connect and update it. The device does not appear on either an Intel Mac or Windows 10 machine, and doesn't appear for manual mounting as a disk either.

On trying to connect, once the device has booted into the update mode, it doesn't progress pass the 'connecting...' screen nor show any confirmation of connection.

Current software on RC500 - v1.02, build 00040. I have also reset the device to try and rule out any issues there.

I have verified the issue is not with the usb cable (by trying two usb cables known to be working), nor does it appear to be from a power source issue as I have used both mains and fresh batteries to try the connection. Finally, this is occurring with multiple devices as both the Mac and Windows machines failed to recognised the device.

I'd appreciate any assistance you can provide.
Thanks
Niall

 Product: VH-10
 Serial Code: G7L4766
 Purchased Date: 2020-11-27
 Purchased Method: Online
 Purchased Store: ACUSTICA SRL (Naples)
 Comment: good morning, having only started playing the drums a few months ago, I realized only now that playing on the edge (rim) almost always plays
 the surface (head), regardless of the power and from whatever point of the edge I hit. I tried to modify all the parameters (Sensitivity, Threshold, Rim Gain, Head / Rim Adj, from vh 10 to vh 11, etc. what I noticed that the sensitivity of the head is very high compared to the edge, in fact reducing the sensitivity to 1 improves a little, but YOU CAN'T HEAR ANYTHING. FOR TOO LOW VOLUMES ... so I assume that there is a structural defect in the plate. Thank you. Pasquale Belluscio
text.value_o:
Product Repair

Product: VH-10
Serial Code: G7L4766
Purchased Date: 2020-11-27
Purchased Method: Online
Purchased Store: ACUSTICA SRL (Napoli)
Comment: buongiorno, avendo iniziato solo da pochi mesi a suonare la batteria, mi sono accorto solo ora che suonando sul bordo (rim) suona comunque quasi sempre
la superficie (head), indipendentemente dalla potenza e da qualunque punto del bordo colpisco. Ho provato a modificare tutti i parametri (Sensitivity, Threshold, Rim Gain, Head/Rim Adj, da vh 10 a vh 11, ecc. quello che ho notato che la sensibilita della head è molto elevata rispetto al bordo, infatti riducendo la sensibilità a 1 migliora un pò, però NON SI SENTE PIU NULLA. PER VOLUMI TROPPO BASSI... pertanto presumo che vi sia un difetto strutturale nel piatto. Grazie. Pasquale Belluscio

text.value:
Issue with Channel RC-5

Product: RC-5
Serial Code: C1M2024
Purchased Date: 2021-07-21
Purchased Method: Online
Purchased Store: PEDAL EMPIRE
Comment: So I purchased this product primarily as a writing tool, and had been using the channels 1 to 7, without issue. No problems. Then yesterday this happened.... I was changing the channel back to 1, using the knob, and had selected 99 by mistake. (which I hadn't been to before) when i tapped play, there was a beat saved to the device on that channel (not by me) and the beat volume was set to (i think it said 300 might have been 200, it all happened so quickly) which resulted in my BRAND NEW Fender Passport 300 PRO speakers being damaged. I checked another couple of the channels in the 90's, which also had beats saved at 200 Beat LEVEL. Also, I had performed a factory reset on the pedal, just prior to this happening. Now I'm not sure who to be upset with because of this, though I know I have a very expensive repair (or replace) ahead of me. Was intending on purchasing the VE-20 today though I prob need to wait for the heartbreak (and cost of repair) to settle down a little before that happens. Massively dissapointed, and out of pocket.

text.name: description
text.value:
[ROLANDBRASILIMPORTAOEXPOR] Pregunta en Pdx-100 | Drum Pad V-drums 10

 GAPOLOP: Is it compatible with TD-11?
 ROLANDBRASILIMPORTAOEXPOR: Yes, it is 100% compatible with your TD-11. You can buy quiet!
 GAPOLOP: This model in relation to the 12" PD-128s-bc, is the difference just the size? Or does it change something in relation to the technology that each one has?
 ROLANDBRASILIMPORTAOEXPOR: The most common comparison to make is the PDX-100 against the PD-108-BC (which is currently out of stock at Roland but arrives in August). They are both the same technology, dual zone with positional sensing. The difference is in the finish and size of the pad. The PD-108 is the newest version with better construction. Thinking about your TD-11 module the most recommended is the PDX-100 which is a little less professional than the PD-108. The PD-128S-BC is another model altogether. In addition to the size difference (12 inches) the PD-128S was built with a high-tech sensor to match the TD-30 module. The touches are much more precise and dynamic and that's why the Pad is more expensive. Likewise, we recommend the PDX-100 as the TD-11 won't take advantage of the improvements that the PD-128S brings


 GAPOLOP: Thanks for the explanation! For the TD-11, which 12 inch mesh pad do you recommend?
text.value_o:
[ROLANDBRASILIMPORTAOEXPOR] Pregunta en Pdx-100 | Pad De Tambor V-drums De 10

GAPOLOP: É compatível com TD-11?
ROLANDBRASILIMPORTAOEXPOR: É sim, 100% compatível com sua TD-11. Pode comprar tranquilo!
GAPOLOP: Esse modelo em relação ao PD-128s-bc de 12", a diferença é só o tamanho? Ou muda algo em relação à tecnologia que cada um tem?
ROLANDBRASILIMPORTAOEXPOR: A comparação mais comum de se fazer é o PDX-100 contra o PD-108-BC (que hoje está em falta na Roland mas chega em Agosto). São ambos a mesma tecnologia, dual zone com positional sensing. A diferença é no acabamento e tamanho do pad. O PD-108 é a versão mais nova com melhor construção. Pensando no seu módulo TD-11 o mais recomendado é o PDX-100 que é um pouco menos profissional que o PD-108. Já o PD-128S-BC é outro modelo completamente. Além da diferença de tamanho (12 polegadas) o PD-128S foi construído com um sensor de alta tecnologia para combinar com o módulo TD-30. Os toques são muito mais precisos e dinâmicos e por isso o Pad é mais caro. Da mesma forma, recomendamos o PDX-100 pois a TD-11 não vai aproveitar tanto das melhorias que o PD-128S traz


GAPOLOP: Obrigado pela explicação! Para o TD-11, qual pad mesh de 12 polegadas você recomenda?

the PD-128S was built with a high-tech sensor to match the TD-30 module.
The touches are much more precise and dynamic and that's why the Pad is more expensive.
Likewise, we recommend the PDX-100 as the TD-11 won't take advantage of the improvements that the PD-128S brings
For the TD-11, which 12 inch mesh pad do you recommend?

Product: SPD-SX SE (Special Edition)
Serial Code: A4M7151
Purchased Date: 2021-07-22
Purchased Method: In a store
Purchased Store: LONG & MCQUADE
Comment: Hello,

I have a few questions about the SPD-SX and TD-50KV2. I have been working through as much textual and video media on the subjects and am struggling with the following things.

1. I want to run the SPD-SX through the TD-50KV2 auxiliary input. When I do this, I the sampling pad only plays 1 sound on all pads and all kits. I think there is an issue with the TD-KV2 reading the input signal of the SPD-SX. The SPD-SX is only triggering the sound assigned to the auxiliary input in the TD-50KV2.

2. The pad volume of the SPD-SX is always quiet though at 100%.

3. When sampling to the SPD-SX from the TD-50KV2, the recorded "waves" are always quiet even through they record at a high threshold and sound loud when recording through the headphones. The resulting samples are quiet.

Thanks in advance,
David L
